description: Why a call was not served. Each harness's patterns are tried in order against the text the far end or the harness returned, then the patterns under "default". The first match gives the class; no match gives "other". Patterns are Python regular expressions, matched without regard to case. credential_shapes are the forms of credential the writer replaces with [withheld] wherever they appear in a record.

default.pattern: not logged in|/login\b|please log in|not signed in|authentication required
\b[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*(KEY|TOKEN|SECRET)[A-Z0-9_]* is not set|missing (api )?key|could not read secret|no access_token|could not obtain a metadata access token

gemini-cli.pattern: GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable not found|please set an auth method
